Excellent dentist.. originally I was nervous and was hoping for just a little patch up but I quickly realised it was more serious and that the dentist here ,( I think her name was Satw leiyng) .. was going to do a much better job than any dentist I’ve been to in England. A full replacement filling and correction. .
Excellent dentist. Reasonable cost .

Crown broke off while on vacation in Thailand. They were fantastic, made sure there were no issues with the crown site and treated it to last till I got home. Didnt charge for the crown consult and only charged me for teeth cleaning I requested. Cleaning service was excellent.

What a great business. My veneer broke and fell out last night. They were able to get me in today at short notice and apply a composite bonding that is indistinguishable to the tooth I lost. Amazing service, extremely clean polite and professional.

Dr Tipapat was my dentist at Bangkok Hospital Phuket and it is so much more convenient to see her at this clinic! She studied at the top university in Bangkok and did additional dental degree in the US. Her dental work is excellent as is her English.

I had a great experience at Laguna Dental Care. The staff spoke very good English and were very kind and accommodating. I had severe toothache, and the doctor was able to see me outside of the regular schedule, which I really appreciated. The clinic itself is very new, modern, and clean. The staff were professional, polite, and made me feel comfortable throughout my visit. Thank you to Dr. Tippaluck for the excellent care. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality dental care in Phuket.

I fractured a veneer while on holiday and was fortunate to find Laguna Dental Care. The staff was extremely helpful, and the dentist was professional, explaining the process clearly at every step. She ordered X-rays but only treated what was necessary, without trying to push additional procedures. The admin team was welcoming and efficient, and the dental assistant was just as professional and attentive.

The entire experience was seamless and reassuring during what could have been a stressful situation. I highly recommend Laguna Dental Care not only for emergency treatment but also for routine cleanings, cosmetic work, or any dental needs. Having recently moved to Phuket, I feel very lucky to have such an excellent clinic nearby. Look no further—this is the place to go for quality dental care.

Very friendly staff from the moment I walked in the door.
The dentist did a very very thorough inspection and clean/ polish.
Followed up by some X-Rays for further checks.
Great service for 2000 Baht.
Very happy with my overall experience. Quick response, modern clean clinic and central Bangtao location.

Relaxing atmosphere in a beautiful, extremely clean clinic. The dentists are  exceptionally knowledgeable and skilled (I asked about their training as I was really impressed; they graduated from Chulalongkorn (the top university in Thailand from what I’ve heard) and  hold  specialty degrees. One is even a USA board certified specialist. Their English is very good, which made my experience much more comfortable. Prices, while not the lowest I’ve seen, are really fair given the quality of the treatments and warm welcome. Highly recommend.

I’ve been seeing Dr. Tipapat Attathom during my time living in Phuket, and most recently returned from overseas specifically to have a crown done. The new offices are modern and welcoming, and the service is truly first class.

Dr. Attathom delivers exceptional dentistry with great attention to detail and care. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality dental treatment in Phuket.

Wonderful new office, had a tooth cap replaced and it was a very pleasant experience. Easy to schedule using WhatsApp, no forms to fill out, dentist speaks English very well.

We found our new dentist.

I've recently been here and had a great experience. From the moment I walked into the clinic, the staff was professional and welcoming. The place is clean, modern and equipped and the dentist solved my problem, amazing!
Thank you guys!!! 😊 …

I am from austria. I went there to get my pin tooth glued back in after it went loose on my holidays on bang tao beach. The clinic is extremly clean and also the doctor and desk lady are very nice and professional. She fixed the pin tooth by  fitting it back in and saved my holiday. I can only recommend this, best tooth clinic ive been too. 🙏🏻❤️
Newly opened dental clinic, beautiful, clean and modern. Highly recommended.

Beautiful clinic. Experiences dentists team. Friendly staff. Great Dental clinic in the Laguna area.

Highly recommended.
I am very impressed with the dentistry here. Everything is perfect and professional.

text: The clinic and its facilities are exceptional, with a warm welcome from the professional staff. Highly recommend this place for everyone!
I had my tooth crowned, teeth whitened and a splint made for my teeth grinding. Excellent dental work!

Recommend clinic.
Very good professional - Dr Tipapat.
The best dentist in Phuket.

On your website you have a few contact options. I have messaged you via Line. No response. Sent an email. No response…. Went there in person to have some dental work done just before 6pm (open till 7pm), but before 6pm the dentist already left. Impossible to contact. Impossible to find a dentist. So….

I traveled from the United States to Phuket to train for a few weeks and decided to have my teeth cleaned while I was here. Choosing Laguna Dental Care was one of the best decisions I made during my trip.

The cleaning was extremely thorough, and I also chose their whitening treatment. The results were incredible—my teeth are noticeably several shades whiter, and I could see the difference immediately.

The entire experience was pleasant from start to finish. The receptionist was welcoming and professional, the dental assistant was attentive and caring, and the dentist was outstanding. I especially enjoyed speaking with the dentist, who studied in Iowa, which made me feel right at home.

The clinic was modern, clean, and efficient, and the surrounding Laguna area is absolutely beautiful. Between the quality of care, the professionalism of the staff, and the beauty of the area, this visit played a significant role in helping me decide that Phuket is a place I would like to call home long-term.

I highly recommend Laguna Dental Care to anyone visiting or living in Phuket. Thank you for an excellent experience and for giving me a smile I’m proud to show off.

The doctors are good. But the receptionist has an attitude. No manners at all. Bad scheduling, rude. I’m not sure what is the attitude about. She told me “everyone pays” and I don’t care. Don’t go here until she is fired.

The dentist at this clinic is very professional. The place is clean and modern; I felt comfortable coming in.
It's easy to get there, and there's convenient parking.
All the staff are friendly and provide excellent service.
Highly recommend!
Excellent ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Professional Dentist.
Clean and sanitary place.
Comfortable and easy for car park.
All staff very friendly.
Recommend 🙏🙏🙏😊
The doctor was very gentle, the clinic had state-of-the-art equipment, and was very clean. The reception staff were very welcoming and attentive. Highly recommended.

The doctors and staff at the clinic are lovely and friendly, taking excellent care of customers, and providing excellent attention. The clinic is clean and equipped with modern equipment. My father had his dentures done at the clinic, and the doctors took excellent care of him, never neglecting to check him, and following up on his progress until he was satisfied. 🥰

They don't respect the client. I came by appointment, but they didn't see me, saying they didn't have time and asking me to leave and come back in two hours. They called me before my appointment and asked me not to be late, but I arrived 20 minutes early. Then they simply sent me away.
